inlines.v: ELAPSE, verb intransitive elaps'. [Latin elapsus, from elabor, labor, to slide.] To slide away; to slip or glide away; to pass away silently, as time; applied chiefly or wholly to time. [Instead of elapse the noun, we use lapse.]
